title: SHERLOC: Structured Diagnostic Localization for Code Repair Agents
title_zh: SHERLOC：面向代码修复 Agent 的结构化诊断定位
abstract_en: LLM agents solve repository-level coding tasks through multi-turn tool use, but utilize half their budget on locating faults before editing. Dedicated localization frameworks have emerged, yet are still evaluated as file retrieval rather than actionable diagnosis, producing locations without the diagnostic context a repair agent needs. We introduce SHERLOC (Structured Hypothesis-driven Exploration and Reasoning for Localization), a training-free framework pairing a reasoning LLM with compact repository tools and self-recovery, without fine-tuning or multi-agent orchestration. SHERLOC reaches state-of-the-art localization across model scales: 84.33% accuracy@1 on SWE-Bench Lite and 81.27% recall@1 on SWE-Bench Verified; at ~30B parameters, it matches or outperforms other agentic methods. Injecting our locations and diagnostic findings into repair agents yields, on average, +5.95 pp resolve rate on SWE-Bench Verified while cutting localization and total tokens by 36.7% and 23.1%.
abstract_zh: LLM Agent 在解决仓库级代码任务时依赖多轮工具调用，但往往将约一半预算消耗在编辑前的故障定位上。现有专用定位框架多以文件检索形式评估，难以提供修复 Agent 真正需要的诊断上下文。论文提出 SHERLOC（Structured Hypothesis-driven Exploration and Reasoning for Localization），一个无需训练的定位框架，将推理型 LLM 与紧凑仓库工具、自恢复机制结合起来，不需要微调或多 Agent 编排。SHERLOC 在不同模型规模下实现了领先的定位性能：在 SWE-Bench Lite 上达到 84.33% accuracy@1，在 SWE-Bench Verified 上达到 81.27% recall@1；约 30B 参数规模时即可匹配或超过其他 Agentic 方法。将其定位结果和诊断发现注入修复 Agent 后，在 SWE-Bench Verified 上平均提升 5.95 个百分点的 resolve rate，同时将定位 token 和总 token 分别减少 36.7% 与 23.1%。
key_points_zh: 提出 SHERLOC，一个 training-free 的结构化故障定位框架，面向仓库级代码修复 Agent。
不同于仅做文件检索的方法，SHERLOC 输出可操作的诊断上下文，包括定位结果与故障假设推理。
框架结合 reasoning LLM、紧凑 repository tools 和 self-recovery，无需微调或多 Agent 协作编排。
在 SWE-Bench Lite 达到 84.33% accuracy@1，在 SWE-Bench Verified 达到 81.27% recall@1，具备当前领先定位性能。
将 SHERLOC 注入修复 Agent 后，SWE-Bench Verified resolve rate 平均提升 5.95 个百分点，并显著降低 token 开销。

llm_assessment.comment: SHERLOC improves code-agent localization with actionable diagnostics, which is more useful than simple fault retrieval.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: SHERLOC 通过可执行的诊断信息提升代码 agent 的定位能力，比单纯的故障检索更有用。
